Subject: Onboarding office hours — SDK + API key handoff

Hi Samira / Alex —

Thanks again for signing up for the trial. Per our call, I booked a 30-minute onboarding office hour for today to walk through SDK installation, exchange API keys, and validate a quick call to your staging endpoint. Details: https://meet.redwood.com/abc123-onboard (starts in 30m).

Preflight checklist (attach):
- Confirm you have node >= 16 or python3.9 runtime available
- Staging URL + short-lived API key (we can create together)
- Any firewall / IP whitelist constraints

If the time is tight, we'll prioritize the key handoff + a single SDK demo and leave advanced tuning for the follow-up. If you prefer, I can also send a short recording after.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding-checklist.pdf

—
Priya Natarajan
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

Samira —

We waited in the meeting for ~20 minutes but didn't see anyone join. I wanted to check whether the calendar slot conflicted with something on your end or if the join link had trouble. Happy to rebook — below are 3 quick options (all 30m):

- Today 2:30pm PT / 17:30 ET
- Monday 07/06 10:00am PT
- Monday 07/06 4:00pm PT

If you're tied up, we can do a short async handoff: you can paste a staging URL and we'll create a test key on your behalf, then share a short screencast + logs. If there was an error with the link, please let me know (we had one other customer hit an SSO redirect issue today).

Also looping in Dev (Dev Patel) — if you can provide a quick error snippet or a screenshot of logs, Dev can triage immediately and we can meet only if you prefer a live session.

—
Priya

Apologies — we got pulled into an executive incident and couldn't make it. The calendar should have been freed but clearly wasn't. Thank you for waiting.

We can do the Monday morning slot (07/06 10:00am PT) if that still works. In the meantime, Alex attached a small export of the staging logs — we didn't want to paste keys in email, so he uploaded a snapshot (api_key_snapshot.txt) with redacted values.

Also FYI we do have an IP whitelist for outbound to external APIs; I can share the CIDR in Slack or during the call.

samira@finlytics.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Onboarding office hours — SDK + API key handoff

Thanks Samira — Monday 07/06 10:00am PT works for us.

Quick notes after reviewing api_key_snapshot.txt:
- The request from your staging looks like it is reaching our endpoint but returning 401 with message: "invalid_api_key" — this usually means the key format/expiry doesn't match our expected header (x-redwood-key).
- If you are behind a NAT with dynamic ephemeral IPs, whitelisting our outbound range is not required; instead we recommend creating a short-lived API key via the console during the live session and testing immediately.

If you want to try a quick non-live check before Monday, paste the staging base URL (no keys) and I can run a synthetic request from a staging runner and share the exact curl command to use. Otherwise, we'll do the key creation + SDK test during the Monday slot and leave the firewall config as a post-call action.

Proposed calendar: https://meet.redwood.com/abc123-onboard (we'll update the invite to the Monday time).

—
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
